review.instruction: Review the selected artifact against the request and input_pr.base_sha. Inspect the full diff and run relevant deterministic tests. Leave files unchanged. Set approved=true only when no concrete findings remain; otherwise return actionable findings. Runtime completion is not approval. Do not publish, push, merge, or post comments.

fix.instruction: Fix the concrete findings in inputs[0].data.findings in the assigned worktree. Run relevant deterministic tests and summarize fixes. Leave final files for the runtime checkpoint. Do not publish, push, merge, or post comments.
